Invented IIIF documents in the shape of real ones, for the offline tests.

- `antenati_manifest.json`: a Portale Antenati Presentation 2 manifest cut to two canvases. The shape (hosts, `pag. N` labels, a 1000x1000 placeholder canvas size, a level-2 image service) follows a manifest fetched in November 2026; the ids, archive and place are invented.
- `ad_info.json`: an Image API 2 `info.json` like the ones French departmental archives serve with no manifest. Host and ark are invented.
